primaryDirectIncumbent.scope: Read-only process, launchd and exact observed filesystem metadata on the two already connected Macs; no Paper operations, runtime writes, install/stage/restart/selector actions, credential reads or environment output.
primaryDirectIncumbent.conclusion: Six live direct Paper seats run on M2 and match existing on-disk LaunchAgent labels/arguments. Their configured bundle base and SDK interpreter paths are currently absent. Consequently no current INSTALLATION/BINDING receipt, source digest or complete source-to-process qualification can be established at those configured paths. No matching direct service was observed on M1. Which M2 seat is the root's current primary app remains unproven without the current app's exact existing binding/diagnostic.

A later exact same-seat release may be an ordinary qualified release under current mission authority, but current installation eligibility is not proved and version/admitted-seat membership alone is insufficient.

Resolve overlap at the concrete effect boundary using the original refusal when recoverable and the accepted existing installer/consumer identity; keep source preparation independent.

architecture.behavior: Verifies bundle/binding/key/SDK, holds per-seat service_lock, and starts the existing external tunnel client with one profile. subprocess.run here supervises the tunnel client, not a bridge process per tool request.

asyncio.to_thread(run, action, ...) invokes the already imported execute function in this interpreter. No bridge CLI subprocess is dispatched.

execute creates a fresh PaperClient and initializes/requalifies the native catalog under desktop_lock. PaperClient uses http.client against fixed loopback 127.0.0.1:29979. This is native request requalification, not a Python source/profile reload.

inferences.supported: Continued ordinary calls from an already-running serve process are consistent with subsequently absent source/venv paths because its modules, functions, reviewed profile dictionary and SDK code are already in memory.
inferences.notSupported: Path absence does not prove that these six processes cannot be the current working carrier. It also does not prove which one is the carrier or what exact bytes were loaded.
limits: Actual configured INSTALLATION/BINDING/source bytes remain absent, so source-to-process byte attestation is still missing.

Not every future action is guaranteed to work: prepare has a lazy import, other libraries may load resources later, and a cold/replacement process requires the configured source, receipt and interpreter paths.
The exact behavior of tunnel-client reconnect/child respawn is outside these Python files; no healthy restart/reconnect claim is made.
